analyzed_vuln.description: `Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject` allocates `dst->data` for an unwrapped ExtensionObject body, but on decode failure it calls `UA_free(dst->data)` without resetting `dst->data`/`dst->type` (or clearing the variant). The caller later invokes `UA_clear` on the same Variant, and `Variant_clear` sees non-NULL `p->data` with valid `p->type` and calls `UA_Array_delete` again, causing a double-free. So the root bug is inconsistent error-path ownership/state cleanup in this function, not in `Variant_clear`.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via `fuzz_json_decode` when JSON drives the unwrapped-ExtensionObject path in Variant decoding (TypeId resolves to a known datatype and structure/body decode is attempted), then `decodeFields` fails after allocation. The PoC malformed JSON (`{"Body"{"TypeId"{"Id":5}"Body"}{}[2]"Type":22}`) reaches this path, causing first free in `Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject` error handling and second free during `UA_decodeJson` cleanup (`UA_clear` -> `Variant_clear`).
